name: Toxic / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. An erupting toxic cloud with hollow pressure pulses and dense papery spores. Keep a rough dry rustling spore flutter constantly audible for 3.5 seconds after the attack; gradually lower its pitch, not its volume. Fade only in the last 0.3 seconds. No voice, scream, music, gunshot or reverb.
